features.feature: Inbox (activity bar, ⇧⌘I) opens or closes the right panel on its tab; its badge counts open items, in warn colour when one blocks work
Open, Blocking and Done chips; empty Open says "Nothing needs you", empty Done "Nothing decided this week yet."
Items are grouped by client, then "Everything else"; blocking first; more than 5 of a kind fold into "N more like these"

Each kind carries its own actions: minutes failed (Write again, Show log), minutes waiting (Write now), a people suggestion (Yes, No, Change…), work to review, Found for you (Create, Not this), a Teams transcript (Import, Not this)
Sign-in, sender (Trust, Ignore, Read anyway, Keep out), permission, older Echo plugin, Echo update and plugin update items come from the real machine and accounts
A clicked decision shows Working… until its item goes; a failure gives the buttons back with why; Open goes to the item's place
An item that is gone moves to Done for 7 days, only when its source could be read
`echoctl attention` lists the same open and done items as JSON
